game_title: Return Or Print – Ice Market Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round, blizzard sprites strike the hold gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the hold gate from blizzard sprites in Ice Market: keep the court_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: court_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Ice Market.
